 theorem terminal_close_never_reopens (pending : PendingTurn) (message : Option String) :
     (sealPending pending message).closed = true ∧
       (sealPending pending message).inFlight = [] := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+
+/-- Native ingress may retain only the turn and writer capability it observed.
+The optional turn convention is the same as the serialized terminal handler;
+an explicitly named older turn must never borrow the active turn's target. -/
+def capturedFinal? (pending : PendingTurn) (session : String) (turn : Option String)
+    (message : String) : Option PendingTurn :=
+  if pending.sessionId == session && matchesHookTurn pending turn then
+    some (sealPending pending (some message))
+  else none
+
+theorem final_capture_preserves_scope (pending captured : PendingTurn) (session : String)
+    (turn : Option String) (message : String)
+    (accepted : capturedFinal? pending session turn message = some captured) :
+    captured.write = pending.write ∧ captured.read = pending.read ∧
+      captured.cwd = pending.cwd ∧ captured.prompt = pending.prompt ∧
+      captured.projectInputs = pending.projectInputs ∧
+      captured.inputBoundary = pending.inputBoundary ∧ captured.turnId = pending.turnId := by
+  unfold capturedFinal? at accepted
+  split at accepted
+  · cases accepted
+    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
+  · simp at accepted
+
+theorem final_capture_seals_answer (pending captured : PendingTurn) (session : String)
+    (turn : Option String) (message : String)
+    (accepted : capturedFinal? pending session turn message = some captured) :
+    captured.finalMessage = some message ∧ captured.closed = true ∧
+      captured.inFlight = [] ∧ observedRoots captured = observedRoots pending := by
+  unfold capturedFinal? at accepted
+  split at accepted
+  · cases accepted
+    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
+  · simp at accepted
+
+theorem final_capture_checks_identity (pending captured : PendingTurn) (session : String)
+    (turn : Option String) (message : String)
+    (accepted : capturedFinal? pending session turn message = some captured) :
+    pending.sessionId = session ∧ matchesHookTurn pending turn = true := by
+  unfold capturedFinal? at accepted
+  split at accepted
+  · rename_i matches
+    simpa only [Bool.and_eq_true,beq_iff_eq] using matches
+  · simp at accepted
+
+theorem final_capture_named_turn (pending captured : PendingTurn) (session turn message : String)
+    (accepted : capturedFinal? pending session (some turn) message = some captured) :
+    captured.turnId = turn := by
+  have identity := (final_capture_checks_identity pending captured session (some turn) message accepted).2
+  have scope := (final_capture_preserves_scope pending captured session (some turn) message accepted).2.2.2.2.2.2
+  simpa only [matchesHookTurn,beq_iff_eq,← scope] using identity.symm
+
+theorem readonly_final_capture_has_no_source_job (files : SessionFiles)
+    (pending captured : PendingTurn) (session : String) (turn : Option String) (message : String)
+    (readonly : pending.write = none)
+    (accepted : capturedFinal? pending session turn message = some captured) :
+    queueCheckpoint files captured = pure () := by
+  have scope := (final_capture_preserves_scope pending captured session turn message accepted).1
+  exact readonly_checkpoint_has_no_effect files captured (scope.trans readonly)
+
+/-- An unbound native answer is private recovery evidence, never a source job
+or a certificate. No current project/profile may assign it a writer target. -/
+def recordUnboundFinal (files : SessionFiles) (session : String) (turn : Option String)
+    (message : String) : IO Unit := do
+  let bytes := (Json.mkObj [("session",toJson session),("turn",toJson turn),
+    ("message",toJson message)]).compress.toUTF8
+  let key := Blake3.hex (Blake3.digest "eggshell.unbound-final".toUTF8 [bytes])
+  let directory := files.directory/"unbound-answers"
+  Persistence.privateDirectory directory
+  FileSystem.immutableBytes (directory/(key++".json")) bytes
+
+/-- Capture an answer before frontend readiness, RPC, state-lock contention or
+synaptic preparation can consume the hook's deadline. Only atomic private
+metadata is read; lifecycle changes and ordinary synaptic ingress stay in Stop. -/
+def captureFinalAnswer (input : Json) : IO Unit := do
+  let some message := optionalString input "last_assistant_message" | return
+  let session ← IO.ofExcept (requiredString input "session_id")
+  let turn := optionalString input "turn_id"
+  let files ← sessionFiles session
+  try
+    let state ← (readJson? files.state stateJsonDefaults : IO (Option ThreadState))
+    if state.any (! ·.enabled) then return
+    let active ← (readJson? files.pending pendingJsonDefaults : IO (Option PendingTurn))
+    let captured ← match active.bind (capturedFinal? · session turn message) with
+      | some captured => pure (some captured)
+      | none => do
+          let closed ← turn.mapM (readClosedTurn? files)
+          pure (closed.join.bind (capturedFinal? · session turn message))
+    if let some captured := captured then
+      queueCheckpoint files captured
+      Receipt.observe (optionalString input "_eggshell_receipt") "final-capture" (Json.mkObj [
+        ("status",toJson (if captured.write.isSome then "checkpoint" else "read-only")),
+        ("turn",toJson captured.turnId),("writeTarget",toJson captured.write)])
+    else
+      recordUnboundFinal files session turn message
+      Receipt.observe (optionalString input "_eggshell_receipt") "final-capture"
+        (Json.mkObj [("status",toJson "unbound")])
+  catch error =>
+    recordUnboundFinal files session turn message
+    throw error
